# cbeta

**Tag**: web, networking

## 简介

Ruby gem for use Chinese Buddhist Text resources made by CBETA (http://www.cbeta.org).

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/RayCHOU/ruby-cbeta
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/cbeta/4.1.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/cbeta
